# From a muxt.json directory, muxt test runs every entry and writes one
# profile. Both packages embed a file named index.gohtml; each block of the
# profile names its own package's file by absolute path, so the two never
# meet.

muxt test --output-cover-profile cover.out
stdout '(?m)^example\.com/m/a$'
stdout '(?m)^example\.com/m/b$'
grep '^'$WORK'/a/index\.gohtml:1\.2,' cover.out
grep '^'$WORK'/b/index\.gohtml:1\.2,' cover.out

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- muxt.json --
{
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/a": [{}],
		"example.com/m/b": [{}]
	}
}
-- a/index.gohtml --
{{if .Admin}}Welcome back, admin.{{else}}Please sign in.{{end}}
-- a/template.go --
package a

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Admin bool
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "index.gohtml", page)
}
-- a/render_test.go --
package a

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRender(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, Page{Admin: true}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if buf.Len() == 0 {
		t.Error("Render wrote nothing")
	}
}
-- b/index.gohtml --
{{.Name}}, welcome.
-- b/template.go --
package b

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "index.gohtml", page)
}
-- b/render_test.go --
package b

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRender(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, Page{Name: "Ada"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if buf.Len() == 0 {
		t.Error("Render wrote nothing")
	}
}
